attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Wisconsin state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code "WI" eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code "WI" eq and

action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22 (Corporations, general provisions)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Department of Revenue Publication 112" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Tax Bulletin 203 (July 2018) - Economic Nexus Guidance" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22(1r) (Definitions - doing business)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no filing requirement." job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /additions xdef
additions /apportionment.state_additions xdef
0.0 /subtractions xdef
subtractions /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"Wisconsin state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income." job.audit_trail swap addto "Common Wisconsin additions:" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Interest on U.S. government obligations (tax-exempt federally but taxable to Wisconsin)" job.audit_trail swap addto "- IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Federal bonus depreciation addback (Wisconsin partial conformity)" job.audit_trail swap addto "- State NOL if deducted on federal return" job.audit_trail swap addto "Common Wisconsin subtractions:" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Municipal bond interest from other states" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Wisconsin net operating loss deduction" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Capital gains from qualified Wisconsin small business stock" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 Schedule RT (Apportionment and Allocation)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4I Instructions (Income and Franchise Tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.26 (Surtax on tax-option corporations)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.05 (Income - additions and subtractions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No nexus - no state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state corporate income tax. Applies Wisconsin 7.9% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin tax with 7.9% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"Wisconsin state corporate income tax calculation:" job.audit_trail swap addto "1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28]" job.audit_trail swap addto "2. Apportioned to Wisconsin: × [Apportionment percentage]" job.audit_trail swap addto "3. State additions: + [Wisconsin additions]" job.audit_trail swap addto "4. State subtractions: - [Wisconsin subtractions]" job.audit_trail swap addto "5. Wisconsin taxable income: = [Result]" job.audit_trail swap addto "6. Wisconsin tax rate: × 7.9%" job.audit_trail swap addto "7. Wisconsin income tax: = [Tax before credits]" job.audit_trail swap addto "8. Wisconsin credits: - [Credits]" job.audit_trail swap addto "9. Wisconsin tax liability: = [Final tax]" job.audit_trail swap addto "Wisconsin uses a flat 7.9% corporate income tax rate." job.audit_trail swap addto "Common Wisconsin credits include:" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Business development credit" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Jobs tax credit" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Research expense credit" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Manufacturing and agriculture credit" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Historic rehabilitation credit" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.27 (Corporation tax rate - 7.9%)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Department of Revenue Publication 112" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Schedule C (Corporation Credits)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability." job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability." job.audit_trail swap addto "Wisconsin NOL rules may apply (not implemented)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.26(4) (Net operating loss)" job.audit_trail swap addto
